name: Render: Metric Dashboard
description: Renders a responsive grid of metric cards. Each card shows a numeric value, trend direction, and label. Produces a data-driven dashboard layout with explicit column count.

tasks.description: Render a metric grid with cards showing numbers and trends.

prompt.template:
Render a metric dashboard using render_ui.

Title: {{title}}
Metrics JSON: {{metrics}}
Columns: {{columns}}

The metrics field is a JSON array where each item has: label (string), value (string|number), trend (up|down|flat, optional), unit (optional string like %, ms, $).

Build a vertical container containing:
1. If title is provided: a text heading (variant: heading)
2. A grid container with:
   - layout: grid
   - columns: {{columns}} (default 3 if not provided)
   - gap: 12
   - Each metric as a vertical container (naked: true, gap: 4, padding: 12, background: #f9fafb, borderRadius: 8) containing:
     a. A text with the value+unit in heading size (large, bold feeling — use variant: heading)
     b. A badge for trend: up→success, down→error, flat→neutral (skip if no trend)
     c. A text caption for the label

Use animation: fade and position.mode: flow.

Call render_ui once with a realistic composed grid. If metrics JSON is empty or invalid, generate 4 example metrics (e.g. Uptime 99.9%, Latency 45ms, Errors 3, Requests 12.4k).

variables.name: metrics
variables.description: JSON array of {label, value, trend?, unit?} objects. Leave blank for example data.
